name: Checkout Demo

on: 
  workflow_dispatch: 

jobs: 
  demo: 
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4 
        
      - name: Show the current Directory
        run: pwd

      - name: List Dir
        run: ls -la

      - name: Show Date
        run: date

      - name: Welcome Message007
        run: echo "Learning Github Actions Day -03"
